texts.title: Uma Manhã Perfeita no Café
texts.body: **I** **am** **really** **hungry** hoje, **so** **I** **go** para **a** **restaurant**. **I** **would** **like** **a** **menu**, **please**. **The** **waiter** **has** **a** **big** **menu** **for** **me**. **I** **order** **a** **medium** **coffee**, **with** **sugar** **and** **ice**. **I** **have** **a** **cup** **and** **a** **glass**. **I** **want** **a** **napkin**, **too**. **The** **price** **is** **good**, **and** **I** **pay** **with** **cash**. **This** **is** **true** — **I** **think** **it** **is** **awesome**!

texts.title: Pedindo a Sobremesa
texts.body:
Igor: **Excuse me**! **Do** **you** **have** **a** **table** **for** **two**? **Do** **you** **know** **about** **the** **menu**?
Waiter: **Of course**! **Would** **you** **like** **a** **plate**, **too**?
Igor: **Yes**, **please**. **I** **would** **like** **a** **hamburger**, **with** **a** **straw** **for** **my** **water**.
Waiter: **Does** **your** **friend** **want** **something**, **too**?
Igor: **Yes**, **she** **would** **like** **cheese** **and** **bread**.
Waiter: **Alright**! **I** **have** **your** **bill** **here**.
Igor: **Anyway**, **the** **price** **is** **good**. **I** **would** **like** **to** **pay** **with** **a** **card**.

texts.title: Lista de Compras Para uma Festa
texts.body:
**I** **would** **like** **to** **go** para **a** **supermarket** **for** **a** festa. Esta **is** **my** lista:

— **cups** **and** **glasses**  
— **sugar** **and** **ice**  
— **napkins** **and** **straws**  
— **a** **long** **table**  
— **cash**, **not** **a** **card**

**I** **would** **like** **everyone** **to** **come**. **This** **is** **a** **really** **great** festa!

texts.title: Notícia: Café Famoso Recebe Prêmio
texts.body: **A** **famous** **restaurant** **in** **the** **city** **would** **like** **everyone** **to** **know** **about** um novo prêmio. **The** **waiter** **is** **really** **nice**, **and** **the** **menu** **is** **long**. **Everyone** **thinks** **the** **price** **is** **good**. **This** **is** **true**! **The** **restaurant** **is** **not** **far** **from** **the** **supermarket**. **Many** pessoas **come** **here** **many** **days**.

texts.title: Meu Diário — Pedido Especial
texts.body:
11 de setembro.

**Sorry**, diary — **I** **would** **like** **to** **speak** **about** **my** **day**. **Anyway**, **I** **order** **a** **medium** **coffee**, **to go**. **The** **waiter** **knows** **me** **well**. **Of course**, **I** **want** **sugar** **too**. **I** **have** **a** **cup**, **too**. **Excuse me**, **I** **think** **I** **want** **a** **napkin**. **The** **price** **is** **good**, **and** **I** **pay**. **This** **is** **true** — **I** **really** **like** **coffee**!

texts.title: Carta Sobre uma Viagem de Ônibus
texts.body:
Querido amigo,

**I** **would** **like** **to** **speak** **about** minha viagem. **I** **go** **by** **bus** **across** **the** **city**. **I** **have** **a** **room** **in** **a** **motel**, **not** far **from** **the** **supermarket**. **The** **room** **is** **little**, mas **it** **is** **really** **nice**. **I** **would** **like** **to** **pay** **with** **cash**, **not** **a** **card**. **The** **price** **is** **good**. **I** **think** **about** **you** muito. **See** **you** **later**!

Um abraço,  
Sofia

texts.title: Entrevista: Segredos de um Bom Garçom
texts.body:
Pergunta: **Do** **you** **like** **this** **restaurant**?  
Resposta: **Yes**! **I** **think** **it** **is** **really** **great**.  
Pergunta: **Does** **everyone** **want** **a** **menu**?  
Resposta: **Yes**, **and** **I** **have** **a** **table** **for** **everyone**.  
Pergunta: **Do** **you** **order** **here**?  
Resposta: **Yes**, **I** **would** **like** **to** **order** **here** **too**.  
Pergunta: **How** **do** **you** **want** **to** **pay**?  
Resposta: **I** **would** **like** **cash** ou **a** **card**.  
Pergunta: **Is** **the** **price** **good**?  
Resposta: **Absolutely**! **Everyone** **agrees**.

texts.body:
Sofia: **Hi**! **Would** **you** **like** **a** **cup** de **tea**?  
Marco: **Sure**! **Do** **you** **have** **sugar**?  
Sofia: **Yes**, **and** **I** **have** **a** **glass** **for** **water**, **too**.

Sofia: **Of course**! **Oh**, **I** **have** **ice**, **too**.  
Marco: **This** **is** **really** **nice**. **Thank you**!  
Sofia: **See** **you** **later**!

texts.title: Um Cliente Exigente
texts.body: Um cliente **is** **in** **the** **restaurant**. **He** **does** **not** **like** **the** **plate**. **He** **thinks** **the** **meat** **is** **not** **good**, **and** **the** **vegetable** **is** **not** **good**, **too**. **He** **would** **like** **a** **medium** **coffee**, **with** **a** **straw**. **He** **wants** **the** **bill**. **This** **is** **true** — **he** **does** **not** **agree** **with** **the** **price**. **The** **waiter** **is** **really** **nice**, mas **the** cliente **disagrees**.

texts.title: Notícia: Preço do Café Sobe na Cidade
texts.body: **Coffee** **prices** **are** **not** **good** **in** **the** **city**. **Everyone** **would** **like** **a** **good** **price**, mas **the** **supermarket** **and** **the** **restaurant** **do** **not** **agree**. **Many** pessoas **think** **this** **is** **not** **true**. **They** **would** **like** **to** **know** **about** **it**. **The** **city** **is** **long**, **and** **many** **towns** **have** **prices**, **too**.

texts.body:
12 de setembro.

**Oh**, hoje **I** **would** **like** **to** **order** **something** **to go**. **I** **go** para **the** **restaurant** **and** **I** **see** **a** **table** **for** **me**. **The** **waiter** **has** **a** **menu**. **I** **would** **like** **a** **medium** **coffee** **and** **a** **plate**, **to go**. **He** **knows** **me** **well**. **This** **is** **really** **good**. **I** **think** **it** **is** **awesome**!

Sofia

texts.body:
Igor: **Excuse me**! **Do** **you** **have** **a** **table**?

Igor: **No**, **thank you**. **I** **would** **like** **to** **order** **a** **plate**, **to go**.  
Waiter: **Alright**! **Do** **you** **want** **sugar**?  
Igor: **Yes**, **please**.  
Waiter: **Here** **is** **your** **bill**.  
Igor: **Thank you**! **I** **would** **like** **to** **pay** **with** **cash**.

texts.title: Entrevista: Comida Para Levar
texts.body:
Pergunta: **Do** **you** **like** **this** **restaurant**?  
Resposta: **Yes**! **I** **think** **it** **is** **great**.  
Pergunta: **Are** **you** **sorry** **the** **price** **is** **not** **good**?  
Resposta: **No**, **I** **am** **not** **sorry**. **The** **price** **is** **good**.

texts.title: Almoço no Escritório
texts.body: **Sofia** **and** **Marco** **come** **from** **the** escritório. **They** **would** **like** **to** **order** **coffee**, **to go**. **Oh**! **They** **do** **not** **have** **a** **napkin**. **Sofia** **wants** **a** **napkin** **for** **her** **coffee**. **Marco** **would** **like** **a** **hamburger**, **to go**, **too**. **This** **is** **a** **really** **good** day.

texts.title: Notícia: Novo Serviço Para Levar
texts.body: **The** **restaurant** **in** **the** **city** **would** **like** **everyone** **to** **know** **about** um novo serviço, **to go**. **Everyone** **would** **like** **to** **order** **a** **medium** **plate**, **to go**. **You** **do** **not** **want** **a** **table**. **The** **bill** **is** **good**, **too**. **The** **menu** **is** **big**, **and** **alright**, **the** **price** **is** **good**!

Sofia: **Excuse me**! **I** **would** **like** **to** **order** **a** **hamburger**, **to go**. **Do** **you** **have** **a** **table**, **too**?

Sofia: **I** **would** **like** **to** **pay** **with** **a** **card**.

texts.title: Uma Cliente Apressada
texts.body: **Oh**! **A** cliente **comes** **from** **a** **taxi** **and** **would** **like** **to** **order** **a** **medium** **coffee**, **to go**. **She** **does** **not** **want** **a** **table**. **She** **would** **like** **the** **bill**, **too**. **The** **waiter** **knows** **her** **well**. **This** **is** **really** **good**!

texts.title: Lista do Dia: Pedidos Para Levar
texts.body:
Hoje, **the** **restaurant** **has** **many** pedidos **to go**. **The** **waiter** **has** **a** **menu** **for** **everyone**. Esta **is** **the** lista:

topics.title: Frutas e Vegetais
topics.description: Vocabulário expandido de alimentos e contagem simples.

texts.title: Uma Manhã no Mercado
texts.body: **Oh**, hoje **I** **would** **like** **to** **buy** **some** fruit. **I** **go** para **the** **market**. **The** **market** **has** **many** **apples**, **bananas** **and** **oranges**, **on** **a** **table**. **I** **do** **not** **want** **any** **grapes** hoje. **How** **many** **apples** **do** **I** **want**? **Many**! **Of course**, **I** **would** **like** **some** **strawberries** **too**. **Anyway**, **the** **price** **is** **good**. **I** **pay** **with** **cash**, **and** **I** **think** **this** **is** **a** **really** **great** **market**.

texts.title: Comprando Vegetais
texts.body:
Igor: **Excuse me**! **Do** **you** **have** **any** **tomatoes**?  
Vendedor: **Yes**! **I** **have** **tomatoes**, **potatoes** **and** **carrots**.  
Igor: **I** **would** **like** **to** **order** **some** **potatoes**, **please**. **How** **many** **carrots** **do** **you** **have**?  
Vendedor: **I** **have** **many** **carrots**. **Do** **you** **want** **onion**, **too**?  
Igor: **Yes**, **a few** **onions**. **I** **do** **not** **want** **much** rice hoje.  
Vendedor: **Alright**! **Here** **is** **your** **bill**.  
Igor: **Thank you**! **I** **would** **like** **this**, **to go**, **and** **I** **would** **like** **to** **pay** **with** **a** **card**.

texts.title: Lista de Compras no Mercado
texts.body:
**Oh**! **I** **would** **like** **to** **go** para **the** **market** **for** **a few** coisas. Esta **is** **my** lista:

— **a** **kilo** de **grapes**  
— **a little** **lettuce**  
— **some** **strawberries**  
— **a few** **tomatoes**  
— **medium** **onions**

**Of course**, **I** **would** **like** **to** **pay** **with** **cash**. **The** **price** **is** **good**.

texts.title: Entrevista: O Que Você Compra?
texts.body:
Pergunta: **How** **many** **apples** **do** **you** **buy**?  
Resposta: **I** **buy** **many** **apples** — **maybe** **fourteen**.  
Pergunta: **How** **much** rice **do** **you** **buy**?  
Resposta: **I** **buy** **a little** rice.  
Pergunta: **Do** **you** **want** **any** **bananas**?  
Resposta: **Yes**, **I** **would** **like** **some** **bananas**, **too**.  
Pergunta: **Is** **the** **market** **far**?  
Resposta: **No**, **it** **is** **not** **far**. **It** **is** **here**!

texts.title: Meu Diário — Dia de Compras
texts.body:
13 de setembro.

**Well**, hoje **I** **go** para **the** **market**. **I** **would** **like** **to** **buy** **some** **apples** **and** **a** **kilo** de **bananas**. **The** **market** **is** **small**, mas **it** **has** **many** **vegetables**. **I** **buy** **a few** **carrots**, **three** **tomatoes** **and** **a little** **lettuce**. **I** **do** **not** **buy** **any** **onion** hoje. **How** **much** rice **do** **I** **buy**? **A little**. **The** **price** **is** **good**, **and** **I** **pay** **with** **cash**. **This** **is** **a** **really** **nice** **day**.

texts.title: Carta Sobre o Mercado da Cidade
texts.body:
Cara Sofia,

**I** **would** **like** **to** **speak** **about** **the** **market** **in** **this** **town**. **It** **is** **across** **the** **city**, mas **I** **go** **by** **bus**. **This** **market** **is** **famous** **in** **the** **world**! **The** **market** **has** **many** **oranges**, **tomatoes** **and** **potatoes**. **I** **buy** **some** **fruit** **and** **a little** **vegetable**, **too**. **I** **would** **like** **to** **introduce** **my** **young** **friend** — **she** **buys** **here**, **too**. **The** **price** **is** **good**, **and** **everyone** **would** **like** **to** **buy** **here**. **See** **you** **later**!

Um abraço,  
Igor

texts.title: Notícia: Novo Mercado Abre na Cidade
texts.body: **A** nova **market** **is** **in** **the** **city**. **Everyone** **would** **like** **to** **know** **about** **it**. **This** **market** **is** **eighteen** **years** **old**, **and** **it** **is** **in** **the** **capital**. **The** **market** **has** **many** **apples**, **bananas**, **oranges**, **tomatoes** **and** **onions**. **Everyone** **would** **like** **to** **count** **the** **apples**. **The** **news** **is** **good**: **the** **price** **is** **not** **big**. **Somebody** **from** **the** **town** **thinks** **this** **market** **is** **really** **great**. **Many** pessoas **would** **like** **to** **buy** **here**.

texts.title: No Motel, Perto do Mercado
texts.body:
Sofia: **Excuse me**! **Do** **you** **know** **the** **way**? **I** **would** **like** **to** **stay** **in** **a** **motel**.  
Marco: **Yes**! **The** **motel** **is** **down** **this** **way**.  
Sofia: **Thank you**! **I** **would** **like** **to** **buy** **some** **apples**, **too**.  
Marco: **Alright**! **Somebody** **is** **looking for** **you**.  
Sofia: **Oh**! **Who** **is** **it**?  
Marco: **I** **do** **not** **know**. **Maybe** **the** **police**?

texts.body: **Sofia** **has** **a** **motorcycle**. **She** **has** **long**, **blond** **hair**. **She** **is** **Canadian**. **She** **would** **like** **to** **go** **across** **the** **city**, para **the** **next** **town** — **it** **is** **not** **the** **capital**. **The** **market** **there** **is** **famous**. **She** **buys** **some** **grapes** **and** **a** **kilo** de **strawberries**. **She** **would** **like** **to** **buy** **a little** **cheese**, **too**. **Everyone** **in** **the** **next** **town** **knows** **her**. **This** **is** **a** **really** **good** **day** **for** **Sofia**.
